{{Quote|Everything I know about Belia Darzu, including the hyperspace route to Tython, can be found on that datacard. I am presenting it to you as a gift, a sign of respect and admiration and proof of the seriousness of my offer.|Hetton offers the location of Belia Darzu's fortress to Darth Zannah|<ref name="RoT" />}}
The [[Anti-Republic Liberation Front]] leader [[Hetton]] rediscovered a long-forgotten '''hyperspace route''' that led to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tython/Legends|Tython]].<ref name="RoT" /> In [[990 BBY]],<ref name="RoT-Date">The second half of ''[[Darth Bane: Rule of Two]]'' takes place ten [[Standard year/Legends|years]] after the [[Seventh Battle of Ruusan]], which ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' places in [[1000 BBY/Legends|1000 BBY]].</ref> the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Zannah/Legends|Darth Zannah]] acquired a [[Datacard/Legends|datacard]] from Hetton containing the information about the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Belia Darzu]], including the location of her [[Belia Darzu's fortress|hidden fortress]] and a hyperspace route to Tython. In exchange, Zannah agreed to join forces with Hetton against her [[Sith Master/Legends|Master]], [[Darth Bane/Legends|Darth Bane]]. This was merely a ruse, however, resulting in Hetton's [[Death/Legends|death]] during his later [[Duel on Ambria (990 BBY)|encounter]] with Bane. With the information collected by his [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]], Bane embarked on a new [[Mission to Tython|mission]] to find the fortress of Belia Darzu, and with it, the secrets to creating a [[Sith holocron/Legends|Sith holocron]].<ref name="RoT" />
